description.value: Desert Hills Ranch is a family-owned farm market in Ashcroft, BC, operating since 1983 on rich volcanic soil at the junction of the Bonaparte and Thompson Rivers. They grow and sell fresh produce including tomatoes, potatoes, and cantaloupe, and also run a greenhouse with bedding plants, hanging baskets, and vegetable starts. The ranch features a pumpkin patch, Clydesdales, and a climbing goat attraction, making it a worthwhile stop beyond just provisioning.

No evidence was found on the website for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any other cycling-specific amenities.
